course.title: Course requirements — what you must be able to do
course.intro: Treat Digital Systems & Computer Hardware like exam preparation: the requirements below describe what you should be able to demonstrate. They do not give you solution code.
plainEnglish: This course is training you to use Digital Systems & Computer Hardware ideas on new problems, not just recognize code or answers you have already seen.
You should finish able to read a requirement, describe the behavior it needs in ordinary language, and then choose the code or method yourself.
